name: docs
description: 오피스 문서 읽기·만들기 — pptx·xlsx·docx·hwpx·pdf 를 읽어 텍스트와 표를 뽑고, 렌더 블록(IR)으로 pptx·xlsx·docx·pdf 를 만듭니다. 만든 파일은 미디어 보관함에 저장되어 바로 내려받을 수 있습니다. 회사 마스터 .pptx 를 올려 두면 그 서식 위에 만듭니다.

actions.name: 문서 읽기 (pptx·xlsx·docx·hwpx·pdf)
actions.description: Extract text and tables from an uploaded document — a media URL or workspace path in, {text, tables, meta} out. Works on pptx, xlsx, docx, hwpx, pdf.

actions.name: PPTX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 슬라이드)
actions.description: Build a .pptx from render blocks: header level 1 or divider starts a new slide; tables become native editable tables. Optional master pptx (media URL) carries the corporate theme. The file lands in the media store. IMPORTANT: pass the blocks as this tool's arguments (or blocksCacheKey) — blocks pasted into the chat reply render a page and make NO file.

params.title: deck title (title slide + filename)
params.masterMediaPath: media URL of a master .pptx to build on (falls back to the module's uploaded master setting)
params.theme: {accent, heading, body, band} hex tokens — the page palette rides along (ignored when a master is given)

actions.name: XLSX 만들기 (표 → 시트)
actions.description: Build a .xlsx: pass sheets [{name, headers, rows}] or render blocks (each table block becomes a sheet named by the preceding header). The file lands in the media store.

actions.name: DOCX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 문서)
actions.description: Build a .docx from render blocks: headers become heading levels, lists become bullets, tables become real tables. The file lands in the media store.

actions.name: PDF 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 문서)
actions.description: Build a .pdf from render blocks: headings, lists, real tables, images; divider = page break. Korean text via an embedded host font or the viewer-supplied CID font. The file lands in the media store.

actions.name: 셀프테스트
actions.description: Offline round-trip checks: make each format, read it back, compare. No key, no network.

action.description: read = document -> {text, tables, meta}. make_* = render blocks -> file in the media store. selftest = offline round-trips.

path.description: For read: the document — a media URL (/user/media/<slug>.<ext>) or workspace-relative path. Extension decides the parser (pptx/xlsx/docx/hwpx/pdf).

title.description: For make_*: title of the deck/document — first slide/heading and the stored filename.

blocks.description: For make_*: render-block IR [{type, props}] — the same blocks pages render. header{text,level} / text{content} / list{items,ordered} / table{headers,rows} / metric{label,value,unit,delta} / image{src} / divider. In make_pptx, header level 1 or divider starts a new slide. Render-fence dialect ({name:'Header',type:'component'}) is absorbed.

blocksCacheKey.description: Cache key holding the blocks array (from a previous tool result) instead of inlining it.

sheets.description: For make_xlsx: explicit [{name, headers?, rows}] — wins over blocks.

masterMediaPath.description: For make_pptx: media URL of a master/template .pptx whose theme and layouts the new deck inherits. Omitted = the module's uploaded master setting, else a plain default deck.

maxChars.description: For read: cap on returned text length (default unlimited — large text is auto-cached).

transition.description: make_pptx slide transition: fade (default) | wipe | push | none.

theme.description: make_pptx design tokens when no master is given — {accent, heading, body, band} as hex colors. Use the palette you designed the page with; blocks carry meaning, these carry the look. A master .pptx always wins over this.

settings_fields.label: 마스터 PPTX 올리기
settings_fields.description: 회사 표준 서식(.pptx)을 올려 두면, 채팅에서 만든 발표자료가 그 서식(표지·폰트·로고) 위에 만들어집니다. 파일은 미디어 보관함에 저장되고 여기에는 주소만 남습니다.
